specs.Compatible Devices: Laptop, Desktop, Smart TV, Car & Stereo

features: 16GB USB 2.0 PEN DRIVE: Foxin Prime flash drive with 32GB of storage for documents, photos, music and videos. Plug-and-play on laptops and desktops with a USB Type-A port, no software or driver needed on Windows, macOS and Linux.

UP TO 25MB/S READ SPEED: Steady everyday read performance for office files, study material, photo albums and playlists. USB 2.0 interface; actual speed varies with the host device, file size and file type.
DURABLE METAL BODY: Full metal casing built for daily carrying in bags, pockets and keychains, with a compact design that stays portable.

WORKS WITH LAPTOP, DESKTOP, SMART TV, CAR & STEREO: Fits any device with a USB-A port. Some TVs and car stereos support only certain file formats or drive sizes, so check your device manual first. For single files over 4GB, format the drive as exFAT or NTFS on a computer.
10 YEARS WARRANTY: Every unit is factory-tested for stability before shipping, backed by Foxin's industry-leading 10-Years Warranty.
